attempts.note: Initial design: an 8-panel, 3.8 m-deep Pratt truss with center-directed diagonals and chord sizes graded toward midspan.
Split the long end posts with braced midpoint nodes and reduce the oversized central web diagonals.
I split both central long diagonals into midpoint-braced CHS76.1 members for buckling margin and trimmed the flanking deck-chord sections.
Kept the split-center Pratt layout and downsized the two lower-force adjacent web diagonals to CHS76.1, leaving the heavily loaded end and central members unchanged.
Raised the top chord to the 3.84 m limit and reduced the two near-end verticals to CHS60.3, retaining the compression-critical chords and split diagonals.
Shifted the braced end-post nodes inward to redirect support shear, then reduced the two outer deck-chord sections while retaining the critical web sizes.
Restored the outer deck chords to CHS88.9 after their buckling failure, retaining the lighter inward end-post layout.
I keep the best tested symmetric Pratt layout, retaining the CHS88.9x5 outer deck chords that avoid the earlier buckling failure and the split, midpoint-braced central diagonals.

attempts.note: Single parabolic bowstring through-truss with a continuous tied deck, Pratt diagonals, and conservative CHS sections sized for the full moving-load and weak-steel envelope.
Reduced the continuous deck chord and lightly loaded outer diagonals/hangers while keeping the proven parabolic arch geometry for a safe mass improvement and to expose deck forces in the next report.
Trimmed the end arch segments and interior deck chord sections using the observed load margins, while keeping the proven parabolic geometry and web sizing for robustness.
Upgraded the two critical end deck panels, trimmed lightly loaded hangers and central deck panels, and reduced the central diagonals to CHS88.9 while keeping the proven bowstring geometry.

Removed the T5-D5 hanger so D5-T4 becomes tension-only under gravity, upgraded the remaining critical inner diagonal/hanger, and slightly lightened the now-relieved right deck chord for a lower-mass, determinate design.
Removed the redundant central deck panel D4-D5, lightened the now unloaded D3-D4 tie, and strengthened the critical central hanger and adjacent diagonal while retaining the proven bowstring geometry.
Strengthened the slender central diagonals/hangers for the full moving-load envelope, reduced lightly loaded side hangers and the D4 hanger, while keeping the proven bowstring topology.
Retained the fully checked low-mass bowstring layout and discrete section sizing, which satisfies the worst-case moving-load and weakest-steel envelope.
